slap a fine on: The city will slap a fine on anyone who throws trash in the street, so please use the garbage cans.
市政府將對任何在街上亂丟垃圾的人處以罰款，所以請使用垃圾桶。
slap a ban on: The government decided to slap a ban on plastic straws, and many shops had to change to paper ones.
政府決定下令禁止塑膠吸管，許多商店不得不改用紙吸管。
slap someone on the back: When I won the prize, my coach came over to slap me on the back and say, "Well done!"
當我得獎時，教練走過來拍拍我的肩說：「做得好！」
slap in the face: Being left off the team after years of hard work felt like a slap in the face to him.
努力多年後卻被排除在隊伍之外，對他來說就像被羞辱、挨了一記耳光。
slap on paint: Instead of fixing the cracks in the wall, the landlord just decided to slap on paint and hope nobody noticed.
房東沒有修補牆上的裂縫，只是決定隨便刷漆，希望沒人發現。
slice bread: Please use this sharp knife to slice bread for the sandwiches, and be careful not to cut your fingers.
請用這把鋒利的刀切麵包來做三明治，小心不要切到手指。
slice prices: To attract more shoppers during the holiday, the store decided to slice prices on all TVs by half.
為了在假期吸引更多顧客，這家店決定把所有電視大幅降價一半。
slice through the water: The sharp front of the speedboat helps it slice through the water quickly, even when the waves are high.
快艇尖銳的船頭幫助它快速破水前進，即使浪很高也一樣。
a slice of life: The movie offers a slice of life in a small fishing village, showing how ordinary families spend their days.
這部電影呈現了一個小漁村的生活片段，展現了一般家庭如何度過他們的日子。
any way you slice it: Any way you slice it, the numbers show that our company lost a lot of money this year.
不管怎麼看，這些數字都顯示我們公司今年虧了很多錢。
slide into recession: Experts warn that the economy may slowly slide into recession, month by month, if exports keep falling.
專家警告，如果出口持續下滑，經濟可能會一個月接一個月慢慢滑入衰退。
let things slide: If you let things slide and never clean your room, it will soon become a terrible mess.
如果你放任不管、從不打掃房間，它很快就會變得一團亂。
slide into bad habits: During the long summer vacation, it is easy to slide into bad habits like staying up late and sleeping until noon.
在漫長的暑假裡，很容易養成熬夜、睡到中午這類壞習慣。
slide down the rankings: After losing five games in a row, our school team began to slide down the rankings.
連輸五場比賽後，我們的校隊排名開始下滑。
slip one's mind: I meant to call you on your birthday, but being so busy made it slip my mind completely.
我本來想在你生日那天打電話給你，但因為太忙完全忘了。
slip away: While everyone was dancing, I tried to slip away from the party quietly without saying goodbye.
趁大家在跳舞時，我試著不說再見就悄悄溜走離開派對。
slip up: Even experienced nurses can slip up when they are tired, so they always double-check every medicine.
即使是有經驗的護理師在疲累時也可能出錯，所以他們總是再三確認每一種藥。
let slip: My sister accidentally let slip that we were planning a surprise party, so Mom already knew about it.
我姊姊不小心說溜嘴，透露我們正在籌畫驚喜派對，所以媽媽早就知道了。
slip into a coma: After the serious car accident, doctors worried that the driver might slip into a coma and never wake up.
那場嚴重車禍後，醫生擔心駕駛可能會陷入昏迷，再也醒不過來。
slip through the cracks: In such a large class, quiet students who need help can easily slip through the cracks.
在這麼大的班級裡，需要幫助的安靜學生很容易被忽略。
standards slip: If teachers stop checking homework, standards slip quickly and students start making careless mistakes.
如果老師不再檢查作業，水準會很快下滑，學生也會開始犯粗心的錯誤。
slip of the tongue: He called his teacher "Mom" by mistake, and everyone laughed at his slip of the tongue.
他不小心把老師叫成「媽」，大家都笑他的口誤。
slot into the team: The new player was able to slot into the team quickly because he got along well with everyone.
這位新球員能很快融入球隊，因為他和每個人都相處得很好。
slot in a meeting: My schedule is full today, but I can slot in a meeting with you at three o'clock.
我今天的行程很滿，但我可以在三點擠進一個會議和你見面。
slot a coin: To get a drink from the machine, you need to slot a coin into the small hole and press a button.
要從機器買飲料，你需要把硬幣投進小孔，再按一個按鈕。
a time slot: Each student will be given a time slot of ten minutes to present their project to the class.
每位學生都會被分配到一個十分鐘的時段，向全班報告他們的專題。
smash a record: The young swimmer hopes to smash a record that has stood for twenty years at this summer's games.
這位年輕泳將希望在今年夏天的比賽中，大破一項保持了二十年的紀錄。
smash a window: The thief used a rock to smash a window and climbed into the house while the family was away.
小偷趁這家人不在時，用石頭砸破窗戶，爬進了屋子。
smash the opposition: Our basketball team is so strong this year that it should smash the opposition in the final easily.
我們的籃球隊今年非常強，應該能在決賽中輕鬆擊潰對手。
smash a crime ring: After a year of secret work, the police were able to smash a crime ring that stole hundreds of cars.
經過一年的秘密行動，警方成功破獲了一個偷了數百輛車的犯罪集團。
a smash hit: Her first song became a smash hit, and soon people all over Taiwan were singing it.
她的第一首歌成了大受歡迎的作品，很快全台灣的人都在唱。
